title: Applicability of part.
partHeading: PART III. ORGANIZATION OF NONDEPOSITORY FINANCIAL SERVICES
bodyText:
PART III. ORGANIZATION OF NONDEPOSITORY FINANCIAL SERVICES

LOAN COMPANIES

The provisions of this part shall govern the organization of nondepository financial services loan companies in this State.
bodyHtml:
PART III.  ORGANIZATION OF NONDEPOSITORY FINANCIAL SERVICES

LOAN COMPANIES

 

     §412:3-300  Applicability of part.  The provisions of this part shall govern the organization of nondepository financial services loan companies in this State. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
